note: OMIM #620775 directly attributes discovery of FILIP1-related congenital neuromuscular disorder to Schnabel et al. (2023) and Roos et al. (2023), confirming these seminal cohorts.

evidence.text: FILIP1 mutations lead to severe neurological and musculoskeletal abnormalities including muscle weakness and dysmorphic facial features in congenital disease presentations.

evidence.text: Biallelic loss-of-function variants in FILIP1 underlie congenital neuromuscular disorder with dysmorphic facies characterized by hypotonia, joint contractures, and dysmorphic facial features.
